name: Zodiac MyStamp Folder (Monkey) (MYMONFDL)
description: This folder consists of a stamp sheet which includes the visuals of the 12 Chinese zodiacs with the Monkey as the main highlight of this piece. Each zodiac is paired with one auspicious Chinese character MyStamp which translate as either Happiness or Blessing. Brief description on each of the 12 zodiacs personality traits are also featured in this folder. In addition, there is a special edition A6 MyStamp sheet with a symbolic meaning of 'to attract wealth and treasure' in a money bag design, spot the hidden lucky numbers on the design while you are at it!
